notes.title: Patch 1.02 - "New software to run this vive" Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

So we had an issue where the game wouldn't run in Steam for some people and tried to open in a new app or it would try to do that each time a new level loaded and take over your audio, but it should be fixed with this patch. Sorry for the frustration, and If anyone is still having this issue after updating let us know!

Oh, and happy holidays!

notes.title: Patch 1.01 - A Few Small Tweaks
notes.notes:
Happy Friday!

We've got a small(ish) patch for you with a few fixes and features requested by the community. Nothing major, but for anyone who prefers [b]snap turning[/b] it can now be enabled from the menu as well as [b]reloading from last save pole[/b] location. 

For anyone who has been having trouble with the lava killing you without you touching it, that appears to have been a bug that has now been fixed.

On that note, in case you find yourself falling forever and can't bring up the menu, [b]'R' will reset you to the last save pole, and 'CTRL - R' will restart the level[/b]. Of course, if this happens please still let us know and what level you experienced it on.

As always, thanks for letting us know about bugs and features you would like to see!

notes.title: Launch Trailer, Release Date, and Going Gold!
notes.notes:
Long time no update guys, but do we have a big one for you now: we have gone gold! Not only that, but we've got a shiny new launch trailer ready with a release date and everything - and guess what? It's soon!

Nov.8th we will be releasing from early access, and we can't wait to see what you think. After all, we took every comment, critique, and suggestion into consideration when working towards this (yes, really), and we know Etherian is a better game for it.

So consider this a big thanks from the dev team - all two of us - and please continue to help us improve even after launch. We genuinely hope you enjoy exploring Etheria, and though we don't want to give too much away, feel free to ask us anything. 

- Ally & Jesze

notes.title: Early Access Patch 03
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Evidently the Oculus patch had an effect on Vive users, this is fixed now. Along with this fix, the movement system has changed based on feedback from you guys. The face buttons are now touch sensitive, strafing capable, and you can run twice as fast if you walk use both controllers to walk. A few visual upgrades to the early access maps has also been rolled out with this update.

Also, one more thing, has anybody been able to collect all 8 hand skins?

Thanks!

notes.title: Early Access Patch 01 is live!
notes.notes:
We've got our first round of fixes and improvements here for you guys thanks to your valuable suggestions and bug hunting, so as usual let us know what you think of the changes!

Patch notes:

- Added the option to use 'controller forward' movement in the menu
- Increased the walk speed 
- Placed more save pole items (now one per level)
- Added a few more sounds
- Various small tweaks, improvements, and bug fixes

notes.title: Early Access patch plans & features coming to full release
notes.notes:
Hi guys,

First of all, big thanks to everyone supporting Etherian, and we hope you're enjoying it so far! 

Since launch we've had some really great feedback, and so we decided to make a quick list of things we've already got planned for the full release and a few that we'll be adding to Early Access.


Early Access Patch: 

Controller forward movement / strafing
More save posts in levels
Increase walk speed / option to do so


Full Release Build:

Achievements
Leaderboards (for speedruns)
Story Elements
Tweaks to mechanics
Waaaaaay more content!


As always, we're constantly tinkering to make things better, so let us know what you think about the list and/or if you've got some more suggestions to send our way.
